approachSeconds.description: Seconds for normal bounce approaches from the retreat distance back to the bobber. The first arrival approach uses a fixed speed instead.

retreatDistance.description: Blocks the fish backs away after touching the bobber. This is added to the size-based contact distance.

averageCatchSeconds.description: Target average seconds from the first bounce approach starting to the bite. This is converted into the gaussian mean bounce count using approachSeconds, retreatSeconds, and secondsAwayFromBobber.
